counting_policy: The OT manuscript contains inherited text and separately evidenced candidate drafts. Running-text comparison, token accounting (a subset), human review, acceptance and publication are separate counts. Earlier NT evidence is retained without new NT work. See ot_manuscript and old-testament-progress.json for exact current denominators.

next_batch.first_step: Access and read the selected Greek passage, draft by unit and compare the exact inherited text; preserve original files and identify unresolved choices.
next_batch.parallel_review_debt: Complete token accounting and specialist review for compared passages. Genesis 4:7 token accounting does not resolve pronoun antecedents. Jonah 2:7 and 2:10 remain open.
next_batch.source_policy: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 provisional base with inherited book-specific records; Daniel uses Old Greek. No new Göttingen or full apparatus collation claimed.

word_studies.notes: Five John pilot drafts plus three Romans–James drafts. Three total include consulted preliminary lexical evidence; none is credited as completed specialist review. James 2:24 draft prepared; live inventory, highlighting adapter, staging integration and publication remain unstarted.
